domain: Telco device subsidies · plan commitments · penalty consultations (de-identified synthetic data)

tables.title: Device master
tables.description: Reference data for the mobile handsets on sale. The retail price is the list price before any subsidy is deducted (VAT included, KRW).

columns.name: device_id
columns.description: Device identifier (primary key). Referenced by the subsidy policy table and by customer contracts.

columns.name: device_name
columns.description: Device display name (model name + storage), e.g. Galaxy S26 Ultra 256GB

columns.name: factory_price_krw
columns.description: Retail price (KRW, VAT included). Net purchase price = retail price − total subsidy

tables.title: Plan master
tables.description: Reference data for mobile plans. The baseline flag (is_baseline_tier) decides the 180-day retention rule.

columns.name: tier_category
columns.description: Plan tier category: 5G_HIGH · 5G_MID · BELOW_BASELINE (below the baseline tier) · SENIOR_WELFARE (senior/welfare-only plan)

columns.name: is_baseline_tier
columns.description: Whether the plan is at or above the 180-day retention baseline tier (KRW 45,000/month). Downgrading to a plan where this is false is subject to clawback

columns.name: selective_discount_rate
columns.description: Monthly fee discount rate of the 25% discount contract (0.25 = 25% off the monthly fee)

tables.title: Subsidy policy table by device and plan
tables.description: The subsidy published for each device and plan combination. One row = one (device, plan) combination.

columns.name: base_subsidy_krw
columns.description: Public subsidy (KRW). The base subsidy published by the carrier and the basis for calculating the clawback

columns.name: additional_subsidy_krw
columns.description: Retailer additional subsidy (KRW). Up to 15% of the public subsidy. Total subsidy = public subsidy + retailer additional subsidy

tables.title: Customer contract ledger
tables.description: Activation contract per customer. Elapsed days are calculated as of the reference date 2026-09-27.

columns.name: policy_id
columns.description: Subsidy policy applied at activation (references subsidy_policies.policy_id; empty for a 25% discount contract)

columns.name: contract_type
columns.description: Contract type: PUBLIC_SUBSIDY (public subsidy) · SELECTIVE_25PCT (25% discount contract)

columns.name: elapsed_days
columns.description: Elapsed days since activation (as of the reference date 2026-09-27)

columns.name: granted_subsidy_krw
columns.description: Total subsidy received at activation (public + retailer, KRW). 0 for a 25% discount contract

columns.name: welfare_status
columns.description: Welfare / exemption status: NONE · SENIOR_EXEMPT (eligible for the senior/welfare exemption) · MILITARY_PAUSE_ELIGIBLE (eligible for the military service pause)
